'''2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000<ref name="tr-d705" />
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada; Vacation Village Hotel and Casino, Las Vegas, Nevada<ref name="tr-d705" />
* '''Players:''' 52<ref name="tr-d705" />

Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam Tim Guzman Info Brokers LS Vegas Slam Deck]] ([[Tim Guzman]], [[Light]]; 4th) — "It helped me get 4th place at the slam"
* [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam Tim Guzman Info Broker's Vegas Grand Slam DS]] ([[Tim Guzman]], [[Dark]]; 4th) — "what I played for dark side at the Grand Slam"

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Kyle Craft says the second-place player finished on 10 (+96), six differential ahead of his 10 (+90); the TD's results (Chris Hines) give Ryan Schueller 10 (+196).<ref name="tr-d705" />
* Pat Garcia thinks the event was still ruled a win for James Lafferty, who declined the final; the hub and the TD's results (d722) record Ryan Schueller as the winner of the Final Confrontation.<ref name="tr-d712" />
* Michael Girard labels the Brian Garrison vs. Ryan Schueller feature match 'Game 2', but Garrison's own report lists it as his Game 3 (full win by 20), and Tim Guzman's report has Guzman playing Schueller in Game 2.<ref name="tr-d840">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-lvgs-feature-match-2-garrison-v-schullerd840/ lvgs-feature-match-2-garrison-v-schuller], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 6 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-lvgs-feature-match-2-garrison-v-schullerd840/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* Michael Girard labels the Brian Garrison vs. Ryan Schueller feature match 'Game 2', but Garrison's own report lists it as his Game 3 (full win by 20), and Tim Guzman's report has Guzman playing Schueller in Game 2.<ref name="tr-d840" />
